title: A foundation model for acute abdomen diagnosis stratification and triage on noncontrast computed tomography
authors_text: Chao Zhu*, Ruipeng Zhang*, Xinyu Song, Kai Shang, Yu Lu, Wenjuan Wu, Jian Ma, Yixiao Tang, Zhongzheng Cao, Li Shen, Jianyong Wei, Lisong Dai, Ping Wang, Dan Wang, Xiaoer Wei, Qing Lu#, Lei Zhang#, Tianle Wang#, Yuehua Li#. * Co-first authors. # Corresponding authors.
abstract: AbdomenNet is a multi-task foundation model for non-contrast CT that detects 11 acute abdominal conditions and performs three risk-stratification subtasks. Pretrained on over 100,000 NCCT examinations and fine-tuned on nearly 6,000 annotated cases, it reaches a macro-average AUROC of 0.919 for five emergent conditions across three independent external cohorts. In a multi-reader multi-case crossover study, AI assistance raised radiologists' mean AUROC from 0.812 to 0.924 and cut median reading time by 52.5 seconds per case; workflow simulation indicates AI-driven case prioritization could shorten median report turnaround by 37 minutes.
